title: Memory as Maintained Coupling: A Kuramoto Model Formalization of Synchronization Dynamics and Developmental Pruning in Neural Systems
description: Complete open-source Python simulation library, reproducibility suite, Jupyter/Colab notebooks, empirical hippocampal CA3 developmental pruning calibration, 2x2 factorial Kaplan-Meier escape analysis, Kramers scaling verification, and manuscript files for 'Memory as Maintained Coupling: A Kuramoto Model Formalization of Synchronization Dynamics and Developmental Pruning in Neural Systems'.
